axes.R_resolution: Specificity of Prophecies, ter'angreal precision, weave taxonomy — the sharpness of form

axes.M_momentum: Narrative arc of the Wheel's turning, Last Battle proximity — forward pull of the Pattern

axes.Q_qualia: Emotional weight: the void Rand holds, the warmth of Emonds Field, the dread of Shayol Ghul — feel of the weave
